target.statement: Leave-one-out accuracy of classifying OCC models trained on normal vs abnormal KDD Cup 1999 subsets (2-class task) is 100.0%.

compute.basis: KDD Cup 1999 is ~0.5 GB; training 200 sklearn OCC models on ~1k-4k samples and computing 200x200 Spearman correlations on 4941-length rankings is minutes of CPU work; the paper's own timing shows 4400 rankings take ~4 min with their fast Spearman, so 200 rankings is seconds.

title: Meta-classification of one-class classification models using ranking correlation and nearest neighbor
